summary: Skip matching inventory range lookups when replication roots differ

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection change.

rules.detail: Compare a bucket digest before looking up its identities. Missing-payload proofs, omitted-proof handling, payloadless ranges and listing rotation retain their existing behavior.

compatibility.detail: No wire, capability, digest or signature rule changes. Authority revision wakes remain unchanged because equal inventory roots do not certify signature delivery.

recovery.detail: An earlier binary can read all existing data and resumes its previous matching-range lookup behavior.
